headline: Powerball Winner Rebuilds Hometown After Fire
meta_description: Edwin Castro, who won a $2.04 billion Powerball jackpot, is using his fortune to help Altadena rebuild after devastating fires.
summary_short: A record Powerball winner is investing $10 million in fire-damaged Altadena lots to build homes for families—not investors—in his native community.
body:
Edwin Castro, an Altadena native who won a record $2.04 billion Powerball jackpot in 2022, is channeling his fortune toward rebuilding his hometown. He has purchased 15 fire-ravaged lots for roughly $10 million, with plans to construct single-family homes for owner-occupants rather than rental investors.

The decision reflects a rare commitment to community recovery that goes beyond charitable giving. By targeting owner-occupied homes instead of rental properties, Castro is prioritizing long-term stability for families looking to rebuild their lives in Altadena after the fires devastated the area.

His investment signals a path forward for fire-damaged communities: using private resources to support homeownership and community resilience rather than speculation or corporate acquisition of vulnerable land.
quick_facts: Edwin Castro won $2.04 billion Powerball jackpot in 2022
Purchased 15 fire-damaged lots in Altadena for ~$10 million
Plans single-family homes for owner-occupants, not investors
Castro is a native of Altadena, his hometown
